inventory.unsafe_method_note: POST /api/search returns employee-linked free text and requires sensitive.read; legacy /api/sessions and deprecated operations are retired with HTTP 410.

confirmed_failures.failure: Concurrent WorkspaceStore instances could overwrite each other's read-modify-write updates.
confirmed_failures.reproduction: Eight stores registered 64 datasets concurrently; only 19 remained before the fix.
confirmed_failures.correction: A process-wide registry transaction lock now covers complete mutation operations.

confirmed_failures.failure: Dataset metadata was registered before its durable artifact, allowing a failed artifact write to leave a ghost dataset version.
confirmed_failures.correction: Uploads persist an atomic artifact first, then register and activate metadata in one registry transition; failed registry commits remove the unregistered artifact.

confirmed_failures.failure: Early authentication, authorization, origin, and retired-route responses did not consistently carry Cache-Control: no-store.
confirmed_failures.correction: Every security-boundary JSON denial for /api now carries no-store.

confirmed_failures.failure: Investigation session metadata did not retain the actor identity already established at the API boundary.
confirmed_failures.correction: New sessions record actor_id and an established session cannot be reused by a different actor.

confirmed_failures.failure: An authenticated remote viewer could reach every GET endpoint, including individual employee routes, semantic search, and detailed control-plane records.
confirmed_failures.correction: Every read path is now classified. Viewers receive minimized health, status and schema-template surfaces only; workforce evidence requires analyst dataset access, control-plane reads require analyst workspace access, employee-linked semantic search requires sensitive.read, individual routes are prohibited, and deprecated routes return 410.

confirmed_failures.failure: A response labelled aggregate could expose exact measures for a one-person department or other small cell.
confirmed_failures.correction: Remote viewers cannot access workforce metric endpoints. Segmented analytics additionally suppress cells below 10 in the analytics contract as defense in depth.

coverage: actual remote-viewer requests to every declared unsafe-method API operation
actual remote-viewer requests to every declared GET operation
viewer, analyst and owner read-scope separation for aggregate, control-plane and employee-linked text evidence
viewer denial before a synthetic singleton department response can be rendered
deny-before-body-validation for mutations and explicit POST read authorization
local desktop owner access on random ports plus supported development origins
host, origin, forwarded-header, bearer-token and server-role boundaries
64 concurrent registry transitions across eight store instances
corrupt-registry exact-byte quarantine and recovery invalidation
dataset/model activation, restart provenance and snapshot-switch containment

limits: The registry lock coordinates threads and store instances in one desktop process; multi-process shared-registry operation is outside the supported boundary.
Configured bearer-token roles remain a local-first access boundary, not enterprise SSO or a multi-user identity provider.
Recovery rebuilds metadata only and remains degraded until a source dataset is explicitly reconciled and activated.
This track does not establish retention policy, key management, tenant isolation, or production load SLOs.
